value.text: Correspondence on Leonardo's leave, August to December 1506

claims.statement: Letters between Charles d'Amboise, Geoffroy Carles and Soderini on extending Leonardo's leave in Milan, newly edited by Fagnart and Miesse (2015). A letter of 9 October 1506 complaining that Leonardo had made only a small beginning on the Anghiari work is often quoted.

sources.cite: Fagnart and Miesse, 'Perché havemo bisogno ancora de maestro Leonardo', new edition of the letters of August to December 1506 between Charles d'Amboise, Geoffroy Carles and Piero Soderini, Raccolta Vinciana XXXVI (2015), pp. 47 to 76.
